_note: Live 2026-10-03: GET /cards/search?unique=cards&q=<q> total_cards only (14 requests, 1/s). Default search vs the same query with include:extras. is:funny shows every funny card without include:extras (1476 both ways), so it reveals extras the way t:token does. is:digital, is:alchemy and is:unique show fewer than with include:extras, so they do not reveal; the others (brawler, oathbreaker, has:watermark) have no hidden cards in either mode.
